blocks.text: Guildford homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Guildford, September 2026. Detached houses: 49 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 4% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 161 listed at month end and 12 sold in September, a sales ratio of 7% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 15 over 4 months against an average of 40.2 listed, about 10.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 6 sold. condos and townhomes sold 66 over 4 months against an average of 156.0 listed, about 9.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 23 sold.
